parties.respondent: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. & Ors.

summary: Tax liability under Sales Tax Act, 1993 and VAT Act, 2003; whether vehicle/crane hire agreements constitute deemed sale via transfer of right-to-use under Art.366(29A)(d); constitutional validity of tax provisions; distinction between goods sale and service provision; interpretation of 46th Amendment; service tax applicability; multiple appeals consolidated on common legal questions; High Court's finding of transfer-of-use rejected.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgments reversed; transactions not deemed sale; no tax liability under Sales Tax/VAT Acts; liability under service tax applicable.
